question: Where can I get a list of biogas and biomethane projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity, developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No national list of biogas/RNG projects in permitting was found. Stage and date are documented only in local records: CEQAnet (California) follows projects through dated filings, e.g. Orland Power Solutions, Manteca (MND 2026-06-02, county approval 2026-07-16, air district 2026-09-09) and Couco Creek, Turlock (approval 2025-08-21). EPA LMOP (102 landfill RNG projects) and AgSTAR (73 farm digesters) give construction status without permit dates; CDFA lists California grants. Capacity is not published.
main_caveats: Approval is not construction: CEQA notices of determination show decisions (Manteca 2026-07-16 and 2026-09-09); no start-of-construction or operation document was found.
LMOP (September 2024) and AgSTAR (June 2024) status fields are stale: 8 planned LMOP rows and 49 of 73 AgSTAR construction rows have expected years already past.
LMOP 'Planned', AgSTAR 'Construction' and CDFA funding data are not permitting stages; their dates are anticipated starts or grant dates.
No project capacity is published in the records opened; LMOP and AgSTAR give landfill-gas or raw-biogas volumes, not RNG output.
Wisconsin WARP documents are behind page postbacks and were not read; Oregon and county portals outside California were not checked.
answer.confidence_reason: Two projects were followed to dated approval documents and counts come from downloaded files; coverage outside California and Wisconsin, and permit texts with capacity, were not checked.

attributes.note: CEQAnet gives address, parcel and some coordinates (California); LMOP gives landfill coordinates via a join; AgSTAR and CDFA give city and county.
attributes.gap_note: County and state permit records outside California and Wisconsin, and Oregon, were not checked.

attributes.note: No project RNG capacity found. LMOP gives landfill-gas input (19 of 102 rows); AgSTAR raw biogas cu ft/day (16 of 73); CEQA records give truck trips and buildings only.
attributes.gap_note: Full mitigated negative declarations, air-district evaluations and Wisconsin permit documents, which may state capacity, were not read.

attributes.note: CEQAnet names the applicant (Orland Power Solutions, Couco Creek Dairy Biogas); LMOP developer on 79 of 102 RNG rows; AgSTAR and CDFA name developer companies.
attributes.gap_note: Projects outside California and landfills in other states' permit portals were not matched to developers.

attributes.note: CEQAnet document types give stage (consultation, negative declaration, approval); Wisconsin WARP gives permit milestones. LMOP, AgSTAR, CDFA: construction or funding status only.
attributes.gap_note: No national stage field exists; only two California projects and one Wisconsin facility were followed to stage documents.

attributes.note: CEQAnet Received and Approved On dates and WARP milestone dates; LMOP anticipated start and CDFA grant dates are not stage dates.
attributes.gap_note: Dates exist only for records opened; there is no national list of stage dates.

sources.name: CEQAnet: California CEQA database of project records and filed documents
sources.publisher: California Governor's Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation (LCI), State Clearinghouse
sources.format: HTML record pages, per-document CSV export and PDF attachments
sources.adds: Only source found that follows a named project through dated documents: early consultation, negative declaration, county notice of determination and air-district notice, with applicant, parcel and sometimes coordinates.
sources.summary: Dated CEQA documents with applicant and site: for example Orland Power Solutions (Manteca) MND 2026-06-02, county approval 2026-07-16, air-district approval 2026-09-09.
sources.coverage_note: California only; approval stages, no capacity; keyword search not scriptable.
caveats: Notice of determination = approved, not built.

coverage.geographic: California projects whose lead agencies file CEQA documents with the State Clearinghouse; the 2026 filter alone returned 18,765 documents of every project type.

attempts.note: No capacity field exists; two records checked describe equipment and truck trips only.

inclusion_rule.value: Documents filed by lead or responsible agencies: notices of preparation, early consultation, negative declarations, notices of determination and exemption.

reference_date.value: Search results on 2026-11-24 listed documents received on 2026-11-23.

exclusions.value: Projects outside California; projects not subject to CEQA or not filed with the State Clearinghouse; a notice of determination is posted only after approval.

key_fields.meaning: Project key; the record URL is https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/<SCH>/<document number>.
CON early consultation, NEG or MND negative declaration, NOD notice of determination (approval made), NOE exemption.
Filing date and, on a notice of determination, the date the agency approved the project.
County or district that decides; an air district can file its own notice as responsible agency.
Free text with applicant, equipment and sometimes gas destination.

key_fields.field: Project Applicant contact; Location (cities, counties, parcel, cross streets, coordinates)
key_fields.meaning: Developer and site; coordinates only on some records.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2026060079/1 (and /2, /3) ; per-document CSV: curl -sL -o doc3.csv 'https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/Search?Sch=2026060079&DocumentId=3&OutputFormat=CSV' ; attachment link pattern /2026060079/3/Attachment/<id> is on each record page.
how_to_use.example_result: SCH 2026060079, Lead Agency San Joaquin County: document 1 MND received 6/2/2026; document 2 NOD received 7/22/2026, approved 7/16/2026 by the County Planning Commission; document 3 NOD received 9/11/2026, approved 9/9/2026 by the San Joaquin Valley APCD; applicant Orland Power Solutions, LLC; 8350 E Brady Road, Manteca; APN 257-220-04, -05; 37°43'44"N 121°11'52"W.
steps: Find the project: the keyword box is a Google Custom Search (not reproducible with curl); use Advanced Search facets (county, document type, dates) or links from county and air-district pages.
Open each document number of the SCH (1, 2, 3...) to get stage and date; the CSV export of a document gives the same fields.
Read the attachment PDF (notice of determination) for project location and approving agency.
Search other keys (permit number such as PA-2500075 or APCD project N-1261215) in the record text to link county and district records.
reading_traps: The title is usually a permit number (PA-2500075, PLN2025-0011), not a project name; the same project appears with several titles.
A notice of determination means the approval has happened; 'Received' is the filing date, 'Approved On' the decision date. The county and the air district file separate notices for one SCH.
No capacity: Orland gives only 'two 7,200 square foot digester buildings' and 12 truck trips a month; Couco Creek gives 3-6 truck trips a day.
The advanced-search page ignores a free-text 'q' parameter in /Search (it returned unrelated recent notices), so a keyword list of all biogas projects could not be produced by script.
Approval is not construction or operation: no building permit or start-of-construction document was found for either case.

problems: Free-text search is a Google Custom Search widget; the /Search 'q' parameter returned unrelated documents (18,765 for 2026).

steps: Download the xlsx and filter RNG rows.
Convert Project Start Date serials (day zero 1899-12-30).
Join Landfill ID with https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2024-09/lmopdata.xlsx for coordinates.
Confirm each project in a state or local permit record before treating it as in permitting.
reading_traps: Planned and Construction are LMOP statuses, not permitting stages; no permit document or date is given.
11 of 102 RNG rows have an anticipated start before September 2024 (8 of them still Planned), so dates can already be stale; the file is two years old.
Flow is landfill gas input, present on 19 of 102 rows; RNG capacity is not published.
